# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplementary assessment artifacts generated from architecture and workflow analysis.

- [architecture-diagram.md](./architecture-diagram.md): High-level and component-level architecture diagrams.
- [dependency-map.md](./dependency-map.md): Declared dependency inventory and categorized map.
- [api-service-contracts.md](./api-service-contracts.md): API endpoint inventory and service communication contracts.
- [data-architecture.md](./data-architecture.md): Persistence model, ownership boundaries, and ER diagram.
- [configuration-inventory.md](./configuration-inventory.md): Configuration sources, profiles, sensitive settings, and runtime version inventory.
- [business-workflows.md](./business-workflows.md): Core business workflows, decision logic, and sequence diagram.
